translations.answer: Maintainers accept adding positive armature to M's diagonal as a temporary engineering solution and require checking the armature for positivity; however, this only covers larger reflected inertia effects and does not include Coriolis/centrifugal effects from motor rotation and joint motion. Threads also note that if the motor and joint are not strongly rigidly connected, such as in a Series Elastic Actuator, the motor inertia cannot be forcibly integrated into the same joint mass matrix. Before use, ensure that model.armature already includes gear ratio conversion, and do not re-calculate rotor inertia.
translations.applicability: Mainly applicable to rigid transmission models with approximate reflected armature per degree of freedom; flexible or coupled transmission requires separate modeling.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: Discuss and compare independent withArmature algorithm, direct post-processing of M/RNEA, and ABA internal D_i updates; and future actuator/transmission model.
translations.details.attempts.1: User implements Featherstone-style diagonal update and uses dynamics residual checks; also tests ABA with Eigen LLT.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First confirm whether model stores already converted armature or rotor inertia with gear ratio, to avoid double or triple multiplication.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Use CRBA to obtain M, RNEA to obtain b, and check residual (M+I_armature)*a + b - u.
translations.details.diagnostics.2: Distinguish between rigid reflected inertia approximation and Series Elastic Actuator's bilateral dynamics; the latter cannot be forcibly integrated into a single M diagonal.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Simple path: computeAllTerms after which positive armature is added to the mass matrix diagonal, and solve; maintainers suggest trying Pinocchio sparse Cholesky over Eigen LLT.
translations.details.effective_fixes.1: Fast ABA approximation: use D_i = S_i^T U_i + I_rot in backward pass; user corrects to jdata.derived() and reports normal.
translations.details.effective_fixes.2: Maintainers state that armature functionality is complete in pinocchio-3x, but the thread did not provide final API.
translations.details.environments.0: 2019–2022 Pinocchio development thread; user defined Revolute ABA sketch; performance testing nq=37, nv=32; pinocchio3-preview/3x status note.
translations.details.limits.0: Diagonal approximation does not include Coriolis/centrifugal effects from motor rotation and joint motion.
translations.details.limits.1: Sketch in thread only implements specific revolute joint; maintainers note gear ratio; cannot directly copy to all joint types.
translations.details.limits.2: Eigen LLT performance comparison cannot represent Pinocchio sparse Cholesky; user explicitly did not complete benchmark.
translations.details.limits.3: Series Elastic Actuator does not meet rigid actuator/transmission assumption; requires separate transmission/actuation dynamics.
translations.details.outcomes.0: User reports corrected ABA with normal dynamics residual; their testing shows ABA is 20–25% faster than Eigen LLT.
translations.details.outcomes.1: Maintainers state pinocchio-3x is complete, but early preview API/bug warnings remain historical.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How should armature/reflected inertia be integrated into CRBA, and how does computeAllTerms interact with ABA?
translations.details.problem_statements.1: What does the fast diagonal approximation retain and omit, and how does gear ratio and flexible transmission limit its applicability?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Confirm rotor inertia, gear ratio, armature units, and conversion location before real-time force/torque/acceleration prediction; repeated conversion magnifies inertial effects, under-conversion underestimates actuator load.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Early algorithm did not consume already loaded rotor/armature data.
translations.details.suspected_causes.1: User's initial AbaBackwardStep misapplies revolute calc_aba to old data, instead of jdata.derived().
translations.details.symptoms.0: Early version saves rotor inertia/gear ratio, but forwardDynamics/ImpulseDynamics does not use armature in internal mass matrix.
translations.details.symptoms.1: Custom abaWithMot initial version does not satisfy (M+Imot)*a + b = u; visitor data corrected, author reports normal.
